projects.title: Multi-Tenant FinTech SaaS Billing & Webhook Reconciliation Engine
projects.architecture: Event-driven transactional outbox on PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security (RLS), PgBouncer transaction pooling, Redis distributed locks for Stripe webhook idempotency, Next.js App Router, and AWS ECS.

projects.title: Omnichannel Hybrid-RAG Support Copilot & CRM Triage Gateway
projects.architecture: FastAPI asynchronous orchestrator using Okapi BM25 + HNSW dense vector retrieval (ef_construction=200, M=16) with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, Redis L1 semantic cache, and PII redaction guardrails.

projects.title: HIPAA-Compliant Telemedicine Mobile Suite & Clinical Triage AI
projects.architecture: Flutter cross-platform mobile client with low-latency WebRTC video relay, HL7/FHIR electronic health record synchronization, AWS KMS envelope encryption, and calibrated symptom triage classifier.

projects.title: Headless Composable Commerce & Real-Time Merchandising Recommender
projects.architecture: Next.js storefront at Cloudflare Edge, Shopify GraphQL Storefront API, automated JSON-LD programmatic SEO schema generator, and collaborative SVD session-based recommendation service.

projects.title: Zero-Trust API Gateway & Unsupervised Auth Anomaly Sentinel
projects.architecture: OAuth2 RS256 asymmetric JWT validation gateway with mutual TLS (mTLS), Redis sliding-window rate limiting (120 req/min), and Isolation Forest behavioral anomaly detection on authentication streams.

projects.title: ERP Supply-Chain Demand Forecaster & Automated Document Extraction
projects.architecture: Celery distributed ETL workers, layout-aware PDF OCR clause extraction into pgvector, quantile gradient boosting inventory forecaster, and React executive telemetry portal.
